_about: 观里的事 (rules/happenings.mjs; Hanli 2026-11-10: 「小游戏我们有很多种类. 让用户都能玩到」 · 「要放进剧情里, 现在的兽潮是个好例子, 每天野兽来袭等. 后山降妖也很好. 再想点其他点子, 加进去」 → 「可以，按这个做」): the small games reach him as things happening in the world. Each row: `place` (a place id), `who` (a people.json id — the one who asks), `title` (its name, ≤20), `say` (its reasons in the book's voice, one told a 时辰, each ≤30), `when` (the 时辰 it may stand in, rules/pool.mjs BRANCH), `days` (the days of the month it comes on — of the lunar month with `calendar: "lunar"`, the game's table, scripts/calendar.js; 逢五逢十), `after` (a scene behind him) and `deals` (task ids: hosted boards; `once`: dealt only until played once; `phone: false`: a game the phone's kit cannot host, tools/phone/board-kit.json). Each 时辰 lights `draw` of them, one a place. The pay is each game's own (rules/playpay.mjs): nothing here pays but `variety`. Rows only; the rules name no place, person or game (tests/happenings.test.mjs lints every row).
_again: Skill kits a won board of may be dealt again (rules/happenings.mjs repeatable, beside pool.mjs boardVaries): a bout, a run, a wave or a furnace played again is played with the hands, not answered from memory — the 主力 practice Hanli asked for (11-10: 「也可以加一个地点刷其他主力游戏」), and 押宝's throw of the dice. A riddle, a fixed puzzle, a one-answer board is none of these and stays out.
_variety: 变着花样 (Hanli 2026-11-10's design): the day's distinct KINDS of game played to an end beside the story (a board played again, 兽潮 · 切磋 · 妖兽出没, a beast fought at a haunt or pool — counted or lost; a put-down is no play; the story's own boards keep the book's pace) — at the third, one small game's worth; at the fifth, another. `own` in the unit form of gongke.json's (`games`: so many small games at the layer he stands on, rules/chores.mjs ownXiuwei). No 灵石 here (the numbers' own pass).
_forms: The FORM a fight takes, rotated (rules/forms.mjs; Hanli 11-10: 妖兽出没 and 切磋 keep their clocks and pay, their FORM rotates by the creature's kind, least-recent first). `order`: the forms, the first the event's own; each other form names the creatures that may take it (`of`) and how it is played. 妖兽出没: the card duel, or a 守墙关 wave of the beast's own kind (the four kinds the wall's tide maker knows: 野猪 · 狰 · 犰狳 · 鬿雀). 切磋: 格斗 only this batch — a card duel with 秦雁 (creatures.json foe-shijie) needs a duel door for the bout on both clients, the second batch's.

happenings._place: 丹房 is the 药园's (09-danfang and 09-dabi stand there, 闵丹师's furnace); no place of its own.

say.zh: 闵丹师守了三十年炉子，今天腰疼，叫你替一个时辰。
say.en: Thirty years at the furnace, and today Pill-master Min's back aches: take a turn for him.

say.zh: 丹房缺个看火的，闵丹师在门口朝你招手。
say.en: The furnace wants a watcher; Pill-master Min beckons you from the door.

say.zh: 丹房今天人手不够，闵丹师说：手稳的来。
say.en: The furnace room is short of hands today. Pill-master Min says: steady hands only.

happenings._deals: 守炉 is yaoyuan-kanlu (09-dabi's 丹房看炉, folded in: it stands at 药园 only through this and 药园巡夜 now, and an errand that asks for it still finds it); 配一炉丹 and 药材连连看 are one board, alchemy-daily (连连看 of the herbs).

title.en: Night round at the herb garden

say.zh: 天一黑，药园架子底下就窸窸窣窣，阿禾提着灯等你。
say.en: After dark something rustles under the herb trellises; Ahe waits with a lamp.

say.zh: 阿禾说夜里有东西啃灵草，一个人守不过来。
say.en: Ahe says something gnaws the herbs at night; one pair of eyes is not enough.

say.zh: 夜里药园不太平，阿禾叫你一起去。
say.en: The herb garden is restless at night; Ahe wants you along.

happenings._deals: 捉虫 (yaoyuan-zhuochong), 赶黄鼠狼 (chaifang-huangshulang — the 柴房's weasels come over the wall by night) and the 药园's night watch at the furnace (yaoyuan-kanlu: 「药气飘上后山」 · 「天亮的时候」).

happenings._who: The 藏经阁 has no keeper of its own in 卷一; 孙二狗, an outer disciple set to the shelves, is the nearest who asks.

say.zh: 孙二狗被罚来搬书架，一个人搬不动，喊你搭把手。
say.en: Sun Ergou was set to move the shelves as a punishment; he cannot shift them alone and calls you over.

say.zh: 藏经阁晒书，孙二狗捧着一摞书，不知往哪放。
say.en: Books are out to air; Sun Ergou holds an armful and does not know where they go.

say.zh: 书架堵了过道，孙二狗挠头：得想法子腾条路。
say.en: The shelves block the aisle. Sun Ergou scratches his head: we need a way through.

happenings._deals: 拼图 (a torn diagram), 华容道 (shelves to move), 洛书 (a seal to mend) — 洛书 once ever (Hanli 10-19: 「9宫格出现一次就可以了」).

happenings._place: At the 山门, where the 主力 boards stood since 11-10 (they stand there through this now); the 演武场 keeps the visiting pedlar's stall alone.

say.zh: 秦雁从后山下来，在山门口拦住你：走几招？
say.en: Qin Yan comes down from the back hill and stops you at the gate: a few moves?

say.zh: 天擦黑，秦雁在石阶上等人：今天练了没有？
say.en: At dusk Qin Yan waits on the steps: have you trained today?

say.zh: 秦雁抱着剑看你：腿上的功夫，别荒了。
say.en: Qin Yan looks you over, sword in her arms: don't let your legs go soft.

happenings._deals: 格斗 (shanmen-qinyan), 轻身 (shanmen-qingshen), 守墙 (shanmen-shouqiang) — the three 山门 boards of 11-10, folded in. The card duel is a beast's (后山's pool, 妖兽出没) and no board deals one: not here this batch.

happenings._place: 讲经堂 is the 讲堂 (褚先生's hall).

say.zh: 褚先生一早开讲，讲完要考，戒尺在桌上一敲。
say.en: Master Chu lectures at first light, then tests; the ruler taps the desk.

say.zh: 褚先生捋着山羊胡子：昨天讲的，今天试一试。
say.en: Master Chu strokes his goat beard: what I taught yesterday, try today.

say.zh: 讲堂后头又立起了草人，褚先生说：手上见真章。
say.en: The straw dummies are up again at the back; Master Chu says: show it in your hands.

happenings._deals: 结印课堂 (jiangtang-shifa: 讲堂试法's throws, with 结印's lesson as its other way — the camera's, or its no-camera demo). 论道 (lundao) is a word game hosted at 稷下 and needs no 卷一 place; 对对子 is 银月's own pool's (rules/aside.mjs HER_POOL, 褚先生 at this very hall). 师父传印 (chuanyin.json, rules/seals.mjs) joins as three more deals: the weekly lesson (`needs: seals.lesson`, dealt `first` while the week is out and a seal is due — and, by its own `when` + `say`, in any waking 时辰, 卯–亥, so the one who plays only in the evening meets it too; the other deals stay the row's morning), the daily drill (`needs: seals.drill`, two learned seals), and the errand's own step board (`needs: seals.step`, never dealt by the draw — 九节菖蒲 asks for it).

say.zh: 天都黑了，褚先生还留着灯，说这周的印非教你不可。
say.en: Dark already, yet Master Chu keeps the lamp lit: this week's seal must be taught.

say.zh: 讲堂人散尽，褚先生独坐案前，专等你来学印。
say.en: The hall has emptied; Master Chu sits alone at his desk, waiting to teach you the seal.

say.zh: 褚先生把你留在堂上：课下了，印还得传。
say.en: Master Chu keeps you after hours: class is out, but the seal is still to be passed on.

happenings._place: 棋摊 at the 饭堂 (伙房门口, where 马小宝 stands in 古七).

title.en: A board at the dining hall

say.zh: 马小宝在伙房门口摆开棋盘，挑着眉毛等人。
say.en: Ma Xiaobao has set out a board by the kitchen door, eyebrows raised.

say.zh: 饭堂桌上摊着一盘没下完的棋，马小宝说：你来？
say.en: An unfinished game lies on a dining table. Ma Xiaobao: your move?

say.zh: 马小宝新得了一本棋谱，非要摆一局给你看。
say.en: Ma Xiaobao has a new book of games and insists on showing you one.

say.zh: 瞿老递来一封信：执事堂等着要，一炷香里送到。
say.en: Elder Qu hands you a letter: the stewards' hall wants it within a stick of incense.

say.zh: 山下送来急信，瞿老腿脚不便，叫你跑一趟。
say.en: An urgent letter from below; Elder Qu's knees are bad, so you run it.

say.zh: 瞿老把信塞给你：别走大路，一口气上去。
say.en: Elder Qu presses the letter on you: not the long way — straight up in one breath.

happenings._place: The 坊市 is below the 观's map (外门弟子无令不得下山); on market day the stalls run up to the foot of the 山门's steps, and 周衡 keeps the gate's ledger.
happenings._days: 逢五逢十 on the lunar month, as a market's days run (初五 · 初十 · 十五 · 二十 · 廿五 · 三十 — a short month has no 三十): the game's own lunar table (scripts/calendar.js lunarOf, the festivals' too).

say.zh: 逢五逢十，山下赶集，货担子一直排到山门石阶底下。
say.en: Market day: the pedlars' poles line up to the foot of the gate steps.

say.zh: 周衡抱着账本守在山门：看可以，台阶不许下。
say.en: Zhou Heng holds the gate with his ledger: look all you like, don't go down.

say.zh: 今天赶集，钱掌柜的摊子摆到了山门外头。
say.en: Market day, and Money Qian's stall is set up just outside the gate.

happenings._deals: 押宝 (yabao, 钱掌柜's stall — once a day, its own pay) and 灯谜 (zhishi-shen, 周衡's riddles; it stays at the 执事堂 too). 画猜 and 成语接龙 need 银月 or the model to guess and answer, and 砍价 is a shop's button, not a board: not dealt.
